Important: Check compatibility before buying

A 400W panel isn't automatically compatible with every portable power station.

Check these three things:

Maximum solar input voltage (Voc).

Maximum solar charging wattage.

Connector compatibility (MC4, XT60, etc.).

Also, don't expect 400W continuously. Actual output depends on sunlight, temperature, panel angle and other conditions.
